script_text: Pluto stirs your 10th House of career this week, Scorpio, and a power shift surfaces. Monday and Tuesday bring Mercury conjunct Mars in your 1st House, sharpening instincts but sparking clashes; Tuesday is risky as Mars squares Pluto in your 10th House, so avoid career ultimatums. Wednesday Venus sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House, opening a money channel. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when Venus enters your 7th House of love, shifting energy from solo grind to partnership. Late week, Venus trines Mars in your 1st House, igniting attraction and making Friday ideal for dates. Saturday's Moon in your 5th House heightens romance. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Jupiter boosts income. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars squares Pluto, triggering workplace power struggles. Water sign Scorpio, ruled by Mars and Pluto, trust your gut and pause before reacting to tension. Follow for daily updates.
